members.name: src
members.doc: URL of the full image shown in the lightbox.

members.name: alt
members.doc: Alternative text. It also names the thumbnail button.

members.name: thumbnail
members.doc: Smaller image for the grid. Defaults to `src`.

members.name: width
members.doc: Intrinsic width in pixels. With `height`, it lets the lightbox know the shape before the image loads.

members.name: caption
members.doc: Line of text shown under the open image.

types.name: ImageViewerProps
types.doc: A thumbnail gallery that opens a lightbox. The pressed thumbnail itself grows into the full image and shrinks back into its place on close. Inside: arrows, a filmstrip and swipe to move; wheel, pinch, double click and the + and - keys to zoom; drag to pan; Escape to close.

members.name: value
members.doc: Index of the open image, or null when the lightbox is closed (controlled).

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Open image when uncontrolled. Defaults to closed.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called when an image opens, when the open image changes, and with null on close.

members.name: columns
members.doc: Number of columns in the thumbnail grid.

members.name: thumbnailRatio
members.doc: Width divided by height of each thumbnail: 1 is a square, 4 / 3 a landscape tile.

members.name: loop
members.doc: Moving past the last image returns to the first, and back.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the gallery and of the lightbox.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the thumbnail grid.

members.name: container
members.doc: Opens the lightbox inside this element instead of over the whole page: the backdrop covers only the element and the image fits in it. The element needs position: relative and overflow: hidden. The page around it stays usable while the lightbox is open: nothing is scroll-locked or hidden from assistive technology, and Escape, the close button and a tap beside the image still close it.
